headline: Sobha, Fractal Analytics, Ipca Laboratories and Sagility top technical scan
hook: Four stocks close above volume-weighted average
summary: Shares of Sobha, Fractal Analytics, Ipca Laboratories, and Sagility closed more than 1.5% above their volume-weighted average prices on October 21, according to StockEdge's VWAP scan.
